# ItsBagelBot

> ItsBagelBot is an all-in-one Twitch companion bot for streamers: Spotify song
> requests (!sr), automated chat moderation, custom commands, timers, giveaways,
> polls, channel-points rewards, and game-stat integrations. It is a free Twitch
> song request bot — viewers request tracks in chat and they land in the
> streamer's own Spotify queue. Every feature is free forever, with no feature
> gates, no trials, and no card required. It is privacy-first (no trackers, no
> data sold) and source-available.

## What it is

- ItsBagelBot connects to a Twitch channel in one click and handles moderation and engagement so the streamer can focus on streaming.
- The entire toolkit is free. A paid Premium tier ($ CAD/month) only adds message priority and faster responses to keep the servers funded; it unlocks no exclusive features. An Enterprise tier serves organizations running many channels.
- Privacy-first: no third-party trackers, no data sold, chat content is not stored for resale.
- Source-available (not open source): the code can be read and audited on GitHub, but the license limits redistribution and commercial use.
- Runs on sustainable hydro-electric power; the site and dashboard rank cleaner than ~92% and ~95% of pages tested by Website Carbon.

## Key features

- Automated chat moderation: a multi-layer system (static rule gates + a classifier "jury" + a cross-channel raid-signature network) removes spam, slurs, and scam links, usually before viewers see them.
- Custom commands and variables with cooldowns and shout-outs.
- Spotify song requests: viewers type `!sr <song or Spotify link>` in Twitch chat and the track is added to the streamer's real Spotify queue. Free, with no premium gate.
- Timers, polls, and giveaways (verifiably random draws).
- Channel Points rewards, including a Govee smart-light integration (viewers redeem to drive stream lights).
- Game-stat integrations: Hypixel Bedwars stats, MCSR Ranked (Minecraft speedrun) Elo, and Fortnite stats plus the daily item shop, pulled straight into chat.
- Config import wizard: bring an existing setup over from Nightbot, StreamElements, Moobot or Streamlabs Chatbot — commands, timers, counters and quotes. Files are parsed in the browser and every item is reviewed before it is written. Nightbot connects over OAuth; the others take an export file.
- Setup takes about two minutes; rules read like sentences, not code. Uninstall anytime.

## Spotify song requests (Twitch)

ItsBagelBot is a free Spotify song request bot for Twitch. Common questions it answers:

- **How do viewers request a song on Twitch?** They type `!sr <song name>` or `!sr <Spotify link>` in chat. ItsBagelBot resolves the track and adds it to the streamer's Spotify queue.
- **Does it control real Spotify?** Yes. Requests drive the streamer's actual Spotify player, so queue positions stay in sync with what is really playing — it is not a separate in-browser playlist.
- **What commands are there?** `!sr` (request a song), `!srlist` (show the queue), `!skip` (skip the current track), `!song` / `!np` / `!current` (what is playing right now).
- **How is it set up?** Connect Spotify from the dashboard's Song Requests page. Streamers can also bring their own Spotify application; the credentials are sealed on our side and never exposed.
- **Is it free?** Yes. Song requests are part of the free tier, forever. Premium only buys message priority, never features.
- **Can requests be limited?** Yes — per-viewer limits, queue caps, and moderator skip controls, configured in the dashboard.
- **What does it cost the streamer?** Nothing. A Spotify account that can play music is the only requirement.
